title: The mass for pope Marcellus, the voices blended, singing alone loud in affirmation
html_source: The Missa Papae Marcelli (Mass for Pope Marcellus) is the most well-known Mass setting composed by Giovanni Pierluigi da Palestrina, one of the most famous Renaissance composers. This setting of the Mass was always sung at Papal Coronations.
